hooks.command: b=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" branch --show-current); [ -z "$b" ] && exit 0; git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" add -A; git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" diff --cached --quiet || git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" commit -q -m "auto-commit"; git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" push origin HEAD:main >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
